title: 'Sound, light and frequency' turns up in a CERN God-particle white paper

tellings.quote: that I got a hit on that exact phrase in that order was in 2012, about 15 years, in a white paper for the discovery of the God particle.

plain: A man named Brent Friedman says he had been searching for the exact phrase "sound, light and frequency" for about 15 years, and that the first time it turned up, in that order, was in 2012, in a white paper from CERN, the European physics lab, about turning data from the discovery of the so-called God particle into sound. He tells Michels he found it himself, and treats the match as a striking echo of the phrase he had been chasing.
